Compute Reachable Walkable Network Length Metric

Source: R/compute.R
walk_compute_reach.Rd

Computes the total walkable network length lying within each node's isochrone (default 10-minute walk at 4.5 km/h, ~750 m budget). The calculation runs in parallel using compiled Rust and applies the exact partial-edge credit rule, crediting crossing frontier edges for only their reachable fraction.

Usage

walk_compute_reach(
  network,
  time_min = 10,
  cutoff_s = NULL,
  target = c("largest_component", "all"),
  n_threads = 0,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

network

A walk_network object produced by walk_build_network().

time_min

Walking time budget in minutes (default is 10.0 minutes). Users can freely customize this parameter; for smaller neighborhoods, compact districts, or localized analyses, values like 5.0 or 7.5 minutes can be used.

cutoff_s

Optional walking time budget in seconds (e.g. 600.0). If specified, it overrides time_min.

target

Character string. Either "largest_component" (default) to compute only for nodes in the primary connected component, or "all".

n_threads

Number of CPU threads to use in parallel (0 = auto-detect all available cores).

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, prints summary percentiles and runtime.

Value

A walk_reach S3 object containing:

nodes

sf points table augmented with reachable_length_m and reachable_length_km.

edges

sf lines table augmented with reachable_length_km (mean of endpoints).

summary

Summary statistics (min, mean, max, 5th, 95th percentiles).

time_min

The time cutoff in minutes.

cutoff_s

The time cutoff in seconds.

network

The input walk_network object.

Examples

data(streets_cusco)
net <- walk_build_network(streets_cusco, verbose = FALSE)
reach <- walk_compute_reach(net, time_min = 5, verbose = FALSE)
print(reach)
#> 
#> ── Walkability Reachable Network Length ────────────────────────────────────────
#> ✔ Isochrone Budget: 5.0 minutes (~375 m at 4.5 km/h)
#> ✔ Evaluated Nodes: 249
#> • Average Reach: 2.29 km
#> • Highest Reach: 4.91 km
#> • Lowest Reach: 0.37 km
#> • 5th-95th percentile: 0.4 - 4.4 km
